title: Should School Start Later?
text:
Many people think that school should start later in the morning. They say that students are tired early and cannot learn well. In my opinion, this is a good idea. Students need enough sleep to be happy and focused.

However, some parents say that they need to go to work early. If school starts later, children may need to stay at home longer. I think the school should talk to parents before it makes a decision.

questions.text: Why do some people think school should start later?
options: Students are tired early and cannot learn well
Students want to sleep in the afternoon

questions.text: What problem do some parents have?
options: They need to go to work early
They live far from the school
They do not like the teachers

questions.text: What does the writer think the school should do?
options: Close the school for a year

questions.text: What can you infer about the writer?
options: They work for a bus company

vocabulary.definition: paying close attention to one thing
a choice made after thinking about options
the mother and father of a child

paragraph_translations: Birçok insan okulun sabahları daha geç başlaması gerektiğini düşünüyor. Onlara göre öğrenciler erken saatlerde yorgun oluyor ve iyi öğrenemiyorlar. Bence bu iyi bir fikir. Öğrencilerin mutlu ve odaklanmış olabilmeleri için yeterince uykuya ihtiyaçları var.

Ancak bazı ebeveynler işe erken gitmek zorunda olduklarını söylüyor. Okul daha geç başlarsa çocuklar evde daha uzun kalmak zorunda kalabilir. Bence okul bir karar vermeden önce ebeveynlerle konuşmalı.
